events.title: Birth of Robert E. Lee
events.description: Robert Edward Lee was born at Stratford Hall in Westmoreland County, Virginia. He later became a career U.S. Army officer and went on to command the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia during the American Civil War.
events.significance: Lee became one of the most prominent and debated military figures in American history, and his leadership shaped the course of the Civil War.

events.title: Birth of Edgar Allan Poe
events.description: Edgar Allan Poe was born in Boston, Massachusetts. He became a celebrated poet, short story writer, and critic, known for works such as The Raven and The Tell-Tale Heart.
events.significance: Poe pioneered the modern detective story and greatly influenced Gothic fiction, horror, and the development of the short story as a literary form.

events.title: First German Zeppelin Air Raid on Britain
events.description: German Zeppelin airships bombed the East Anglian coast, including Great Yarmouth and King's Lynn, killing several civilians during World War I.
events.significance: These raids were among the first strategic aerial bombings of civilian targets, foreshadowing the role of air power in total war.

events.title: Indira Gandhi Becomes Prime Minister of India
events.description: Indira Gandhi was elected leader of the Congress Party parliamentary group and became India's third Prime Minister, succeeding Lal Bahadur Shastri.
events.significance: She became the first woman to serve as India's Prime Minister and led the country through major events, including the 1971 war with Pakistan.

events.title: Snowfall in Miami
events.description: Snow fell in Miami, Florida, as a rare cold wave swept across the state, marking the only time snow has been recorded in the city's history.
events.significance: The event damaged Florida's agricultural industry and remains a unique weather milestone in the history of South Florida.
